page_title: SAL 1-2 BOL | Salernitana v Bologna 10/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The match has just finished.
90+8' Giulio Maggiore (Salernitana) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Simone Sozza blows his whistle for a foul.
90+6' Lukasz Skorupski (Bologna) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.

90+5' A lofted pass evades the keeper and lands right on the head of Lorenzo Pirola (Salernitana) in the centre of the box, but his header sails narrowly wide of the right post when an empty net was beckoning. The ball goes out of play and Bologna will have a goal kick.
90+3' Flavius Daniliuc (Salernitana) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
90+3' Unsportsmanlike conduct. Federico Fazio (Salernitana) is shown a red card off the pitch!
90+2' Giulio Maggiore (Salernitana) makes a strong challenge and Simone Sozza blows for a foul.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
88' Domagoj Bradaric (Salernitana) commits a rough challenge and Simone Sozza blows his whistle for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Bologna.
86' Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
85' Kacper Urbanski (Bologna) is caught offside!
83' Simone Sozza blows his whistle and it's Simy (Salernitana) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
82' Simy (Salernitana) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
81' Here is a change. Nikola Moro is going off and Thiago Motta gives the last tactical orders to Michel Aebischer (Bologna).
81' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) is coming onto the pitch as Antonio Candreva cannot continue after picking up an injury.
81' Sydney van Hooijdonk (Bologna) makes a rough challenge and Simone Sozza blows his whistle for a foul.
80' Bologna seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
79' Bologna concede a free kick following a bad challenge.
77' Dan Ndoye comes off the pitch to be replaced by Kacper Urbanski (Bologna).
76' Thiago Motta prepares a substitution. Joshua Zirkzee is replaced by Sydney van Hooijdonk (Bologna).
75' 1 - 2 Goal! Antonio Candreva tees up Simy (Salernitana) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the bottom right corner. 1:2.
73' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Antonio Candreva (Salernitana), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
73' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. Salernitana force their opponents to concede a corner.
71' Lukasz Skorupski leaps to intercept the corner kick from Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana).
69' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
66' Nikola Moro (Bologna) sends in a shot from a promising distance after a precise pass. His effort goes inches over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Salernitana.
64' A great pass puts Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) clear inside the box, he sidesteps the keeper but inexplicably hits his shot against the left post.
64' Filippo Inzaghi has decided to make a change. Giulio Maggiore (Salernitana) replaces Mateusz Legowski.
64' Simy (Salernitana) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi.
63' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
61' Bologna control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
57' Ball possession – 31:69.
54' Norbert Gyomber (Salernitana) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Simone Sozza had an easy-decision to make.
53' Simone Sozza interrupts the game. One of the players from Bologna won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
51' Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi (Salernitana) decided to shoot after receiving a sweet pass. The ball went low to the middle of the goal, but Lukasz Skorupski made a easy save.
50' Nikola Moro (Bologna) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball goes out of play and Salernitana will have a goal kick.
49' Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Salernitana.
48' Flavius Daniliuc (Salernitana) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Simone Sozza had an easy-decision to make.
46' Filippo Inzaghi makes a half-time substitution. Flavius Daniliuc (Salernitana) comes on in place of Pasquale Mazzocchi.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Simone Sozza has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' Boulaye Dia (Salernitana) commits a rough challenge and Simone Sozza blows his whistle for an infringement. Free kick. Bologna will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) is shown a deserved yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
43' Boulaye Dia (Salernitana) has tested the patience of referee Simone Sozza and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
42' Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) is able to continue to play.
41' Boulaye Dia (Salernitana) strikes a promising volley towards goal, but one of the defenders is quick enough to step in and make a crucial block.
41' PENALTY APPEAL after Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
39' Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
39' Pasquale Mazzocchi (Salernitana) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Simone Sozza had an easy-decision to make.
39' That's unlucky! Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
37' Simone Sozza shows a yellow card to Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) for his blatant foul.
36' A player from Bologna commits a rough challenge. Simone Sozza blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
35' The substitution has been made. Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) has replaced Matteo Lovato.
33' Boulaye Dia (Salernitana) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
31' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Bologna.
26' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Lassana Coulibaly (Salernitana) was quite harsh and Simone Sozza didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
24' A dangerous looking corner kick from Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) is cleared to safety by the defence.
20' 0 - 2 Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) gets one-on-one with the goalkeeper and takes an early shot which finds the back of the net.
18' The corner is swung in but Salernitana can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
18' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) tries to take the opposition by surprise with a quick free kick into the box.
16' A player from Bologna commits a rough challenge. Simone Sozza blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Salernitana are awarded the free kick.
11' The Salernitana players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
9' 0 - 1 Goal! Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) was in the right place at the right time to pounce on the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball home. It's 0:1.
6' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bologna.

5' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Bologna will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
5' Simone Sozza interrupts the game. One of the players from Bologna won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
2' Simone Sozza blows for a foul after Pasquale Mazzocchi (Salernitana) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Bologna will take the kick-off.
